Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified "Oklahoma" instead of "Oregon" as the location of the 2015 Umpqua Community College mass shooting. This mistake occurred due to the Planner's failure to reconcile the conflicting location detail (Oklahoma was wrongly written in the conclusion) with the accurate information provided by WebSurfer earlier, confirming the event took place in Roseburg, Oregon. This is a case of misinterpretation of geographic information and failure to cross-verify crucial location details against reliable sources.
